Dated : 16th April 2024.

By this petition, the petitioner seeks quashing and setting aside of the Look Out Circular (LOC) dated 5 th December 2023 issued at the behest of the respondent No.
2 i.e. the Senior Inspector of Police, EOW, Unit- IX, Banking 01, Mumbai.
2.

It appears that the petitioner is arraigned as an accused in C.R. No. 176 of 2023,
registered with the M.R.A. Marg Police 26 WP(ST).5478.2024.odt Station, Mumbai alongwith other co-accused, for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 406,
409, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.label: RESPONDENT

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3. Learned A.P.P., on instructions of Mr. Dnyaneshwar P. Awari, Police Inspector,
attached to EOW, Unit-11, Mumbai states that the custody of the petitioner was never sought, as it was not required and that charge-sheet has been filed in the said case.

Learned A.P.P. further, on instructions of Mr. Awari states, that since charge-sheet has been filed,
the LOC issued against the petitioner will be withdrawn by them within one week from today.
Statement accepted.
Learned A.P.P. states that the said decision of withdrawal would be communicated to the Bureau of Immigration also within one week from today, alongwith a copy of the same to the petitioner.
4. In view of the aforesaid statement made by the learned A.P.P. on instructions, nothing survives for further consideration in this 26 WP(ST).5478.2024.odt petition.
Accordingly, the Writ Petition stands disposed of.

5. All concerned to act on the authenticated copy of this order.
MANJUSHA DESHPANDE, J. REVATI MOHITE DERE, J.
